tells.1: Stock marketing filler like 'guidance you can trust', 'keep your recovery moving' and 'unlock more of what the app has to offer'
tells.2: Leftover tidy cadence in 'so you always know what to do and how to do it right'
tells.3: Over-flattened, stilted phrasing ('Each video shows the form for the movement') and vague 'unlocks additional features'
tells.4: Mild cliché in 'keep you moving forward'
tells.5: Vague 'adds more to the app' on Premium

reason: Version 4 has a natural, warm voice ('Maybe you're bouncing back from surgery', 'we'll give you a nudge') that suits a recovery app and avoids generic marketing filler. Its one slip, the present-tense 'films every one', is easy to fix.
